title: 解决方案架构师-北京
responsibilities:
1. 负责面向企业客户，提供智谱生成式AI解决方案和商业化落地，为企业实现生成式AI创新和转型提供技术咨询和支持。
2. 对外负责与销售紧密合作，共同推进产品及解决方案拓展和销售过程，包括方案交流、需求分析、技术选型、解决方案设计和项目交付，致力于助力客户成功。
3. 对内负责与产品及研发部门沟通协作，洞察行业变化，总结技术方案经验，促进解决方案落地及产品迭代。

1. 本科及以上学历，计算机、通信、人工智能等相关专业。5-10年企业级应用架构、解决方案或项目技术管理经验。
2. 具备基于人工智能、云计算服务的解决方案分析和架构能力，了解生成式AI的最新行业动态、应用方向、对生成式AI在各领域落地的路径和可行性有认知和判断。
3. 具备团队意识、优秀的沟通技巧、文档编写、方案演讲和协调能力。能够在快节奏的环境中处理多个复杂项目支持，并以高执行力达到业绩目标。

title: Marketing Intern (Global / AI Native, Technical Background Preferred)
title_raw: Marketing Intern (Global / AI Native, Technical Background Preferred)
responsibilities:
We are looking for an AI-native Marketing Intern with technical understanding and basic B2B awareness to support our global marketing efforts, especially in the U.S. market.
You will contribute across the full funnel — from content creation to lead generation and conversion, with real business impact.
Key Responsibilities
1. Social Media Operations (X & LinkedIn)
	•	Manage and create content for X (Twitter) and LinkedIn
	•	Translate AI and technical trends into high-quality content (product, use cases, insights)
	•	Track and optimize performance (impressions, engagement, leads)

2. Technical & B2B Content Support
	•	Translate product capabilities into compelling content for B2B audiences
	•	Support enterprise-focused materials (solutions, case studies, industry use cases)
	•	Collaborate with product and engineering teams

3. Growth & Conversion
	•	Support campaigns, events, and growth initiatives
	•	Contribute to lead generation and conversion efforts
	•	Understand and optimize the B2B funnel (content → users → opportunities)

4. Market Insights
	•	Track U.S. market trends, AI industry developments, and competitors
	•	Generate insights based on B2B customer needs and data

Education
	•	Master’s degree (preferred)
	•	Overseas study experience preferred; QS Top 100 universities are a plus
	•	Technical background preferred (Computer Science, AI, Data, Engineering, etc.)
Basic Requirements
	•	Available at least 3 days/week for 3+ months
Skills & Competencies
	•	Fluent in English (writing and communication)
	•	Familiar with X (Twitter) and LinkedIn; hands-on experience preferred
	•	Basic technical understanding (AI / SaaS / APIs) or strong learning ability
	•	Basic understanding of B2B business models and sales processes
Traits
	•	AI-native: comfortable using AI tools
	•	Results-driven with a focus on growth metrics
	•	Business-minded with awareness of conversion and impact
Preferred Qualifications
	•	Experience in B2B or enterprise-related roles
	•	Experience creating technical or AI-related content
	•	Exposure to U.S. market or global audiences
	•	Experience growing social media accounts from scratch
What You’ll Gain
	•	Hands-on experience across tech, B2B, and global marketing
	•	Exposure to U.S. market growth
	•	Opportunity to work with international, product, and engineering teams

title: Ecosystem Sales Manager (Global)
responsibilities:
We are looking for a results-driven Ecosystem Sales Manager to expand our global ecosystem, with a strong focus on the U.S. market, working closely with startups and enterprise clients.
This role connects partnerships with sales, owning the full funnel from lead generation to revenue conversion, and plays a key role in accelerating international business growth.
Key Responsibilities
1. Ecosystem Development (Startup & Enterprise)
	•	Build and expand relationships with startups, enterprise clients, VCs, and industry partners
	•	Identify high-potential partners and drive long-term collaborations
2. Revenue & Conversion
	•	Generate qualified leads through ecosystem partnerships and convert them into opportunities and revenue
	•	Collaborate with sales teams to drive key deals forward
	•	Own pipeline and revenue outcomes from ecosystem efforts
3. Global Market Expansion (U.S. Focus)
	•	Support ecosystem expansion and business development in the U.S. market
	•	Identify strategic opportunities and drive cross-regional execution
4. Programs & Initiatives
	•	Support startup programs, industry events, and ecosystem initiatives
	•	Collaborate with partners on joint go-to-market activities

Basic Requirements
	•	Master's degree or above
	•	1–2 years of experience in BD, sales, or partnerships (outstanding fresh graduates are welcome)
Core Competencies
	•	Strong results-driven mindset with ownership of business outcomes
	•	Basic understanding of B2B sales funnel (lead → opportunity → deal)
	•	Excellent communication and execution skills
Global Capability
	•	Fluent in English (business proficiency required)
	•	Exposure to the U.S. market is highly preferred
	•	Strong cross-cultural communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
	•	Experience working with startups or enterprise clients
	•	International study or work experience
	•	Interest or background in AI / SaaS / tech industries
What We’re Looking For
	•	Results-oriented, not process-driven
	•	Proactive in creating opportunities and driving deals
	•	Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
Why Join Us
	•	Opportunity to work on global expansion, especially in the U.S. market
	•	Fast growth into a hybrid ecosystem + sales role
	•	Exposure to high-quality startups and enterprise clients

title: AI院--多模态团队--音频算法工程师
title_raw: AI院--多模态团队--音频算法工程师
responsibilities:
1. 负责agent场景下的多模态理解、生成算法研究、训练、应用，包括但不限于context-aware ASR、指令控制TTS、omni understanding等
2. 负责模型的多机多卡训练、高性能推理等


1. 硕士及以上学历，计算机、数学、通信等相关专业；具备良好的学习能力、逻辑思维能力、沟通协作能力；
2. 有三年及以上语音合成、语音识别算法经验，或三篇及以上顶会论文（各类CCF-A会、ICASSP/INTERSPEECH等）；
3. 熟练使用Python和Pytorch/Tensorflow深度学习框架；
4. 对以下至少一种熟悉并有相关经验：
1）语音大模型的框架&理论，包括但不限于Diffusion、Vall-E/SpearTTS/AudioLM、MusicLM；
2）音频理解大模型/ASR大模型，包括但不限于qwen-audio、sensevoice、whisper等；
3）熟悉omni多模态大模型，包括但不限于qwen-omni、mimo-omni、Step‑Audio、Covo‑Audio等；
4）有业务落地工程经验优先。

title: MaaS-数据分析师
responsibilities:
1. 运用数据分析与特征挖掘技术深度诊断业务流程，精准识别风险点与业务机会，输出可执行的优化策略以支持风控决策，全面赋能业务的数字化运营与风险管理闭环。
2. 负责业务数据的深度挖掘与分析，敏锐洞察业务趋势与异动原因；定期产出高质量的分析报告，为业务策略制定、资源分配及管理层决策提供客观的数据支撑与建议。
3. 聚焦用户全生命周期价值（LTV），针对用户注册、转化、付费及留存等关键节点建立漏斗分析模型。通过可视化看板持续监控核心经营指标，敏锐洞察转化瓶颈与增长杠杆，为提升核心经营结果（如GMV、营收、利润）提供可落地的优化方案。
 

1. 经验要求： 本科及以上学历，2年及以上数据分析相关工作经验。
2. 技能要求：精通 SQL，熟悉 Python进行数据清洗与统计建模，熟悉可视化工具。
3. 软性素质： 对数据敏感，具备良好的逻辑思维与业务建模能力，工作细致耐心，具备良好的沟通协作意识。
